note: Toy routing network (#26): a §2-conformant edge_attributes FeatureCollection used as the shared routing test asset for #27 and later phases. 7 directed edges, 6 dense nodes (0..5), dense edge_id 0..6. CORE PROPERTY (lowest-cost != fewest-hops): from origin node 0 to destination node 2 there is BOTH a direct 1-hop edge (edge_id 0, segment 9000001:0:F, residential, 900 m @ 30 km/h, freeflow=108.0 s) AND a 2-hop alternative node0->node1->node2 (edge_id 1 segment 905512:0:F freeflow=18.0 s, then edge_id 2 segment 905512:1:F freeflow=14.4 s; total=32.4 s). The 2-hop path has MORE edges yet a strictly LOWER summed freeflow_time_s (32.4 s < 108.0 s), so a fewest-hops router and a lowest-cost router disagree. capacity_scale=1.0 throughout. Region: NYC-ish, lon [-73.99..-73.95], lat [40.73..40.75]. Overlaps the segment_congestion fixture on 27583001:0:F, 48800123:0:F, 48800123:0:R for a later congestion-overlay demo. See README.md.

features.note: DIRECT 1-hop origin(node0)->dest(node2). Deliberately SLOW: one-way residential, defaults lanes=1, maxspeed=30. capacity=1*1800*0.5=900; freeflow=900/(30/3.6)=108.0. THREE-vertex LineString: the middle coordinate [-73.98200,40.73200] is a geometry shape point, NOT a graph node (only first/last map to source_node/target_node). This is the edge a fewest-hops router picks but a lowest-cost router avoids.

First hop of the FAST 2-hop alternative origin(node0)->node1. One-way motorway sub-segment seq=0, defaults lanes=3, maxspeed=100. capacity=3*1800*1.0=5400; freeflow=500/(100/3.6)=18.0. Shares node0 with edge_id 0 (same endpoint coords [-73.99000,40.73000]).

Second hop of the FAST 2-hop alternative node1->dest(node2). Same motorway way 905512, next sub-segment seq=1 after a pgRouting split. defaults lanes=3, maxspeed=100. capacity=3*1800*1.0=5400; freeflow=400/(100/3.6)=14.4. Shares node2 with edge_id 0 (same endpoint coords [-73.97000,40.74000]). Path total freeflow node0->node1->node2 = 18.0 + 14.4 = 32.4 s < 108.0 s direct.

ONE-WAY primary (single direction, one row). Reuses segment_id 27583001:0:F which also appears in the segment_congestion fixture, so a congestion overlay is demoable later. defaults lanes=2, maxspeed=60. capacity=2*1800*0.8=2880; freeflow=240/(60/3.6)=14.4. Shares node2 with edges 0 and 2.

TWO-WAY secondary, FORWARD half of the F/R pair (reused segment_id 48800123:0:F, also in the segment_congestion fixture). defaults lanes=2, maxspeed=50. capacity=2*1800*0.7=2520; freeflow=180/(50/3.6)=12.96. node3->node4.

TWO-WAY secondary, REVERSE half of the F/R pair (reused segment_id 48800123:0:R, also in the segment_congestion fixture). Same way+seq as edge_id 4, dir=R: source_node/target_node swapped (node4->node3) AND the LineString coordinates reversed (source-first/target-last preserved per direction). Same split-default lanes_effective=2 and derived values.

One-way trunk, defaults lanes=2, maxspeed=80, exercises class_factor 0.9. capacity=2*1800*0.9=3240; freeflow=400/(80/3.6)=18.0. THREE-vertex LineString: the middle coordinate [-73.95700,40.74650] is a geometry shape point, NOT a graph node. node4->node5.
